title.rendered: Mt. Diablo Amateur Radio Club begins Technician Class Course on January 10th General Class begins March 28th

content.rendered:
2019 Ham Radio Licensing Course Registration Available Now!

If you have friends thinking of getting a Ham Radio License or upgrading please tell them the Mt. Diablo Amateur Radio Club will be holding an 8 week course where you can learn everything you need to earn your 1st level Technician Class and the 2nd level General Class is 9 weeks.

The Technician Class license is your entry to the world-wide excitement of Amateur Radio and Emergency Communications… and now you do NOT need to learn Morse code!  Class Size is limited. During the recent wildfires, Ham radios worked when the cell towers burned.

Technician Class Course begins on… Thursday, January 10, 2019 while the General Class begins Thursday, March 28th, 2019.  The First Class starts at 6:30pm while  the rest are from 7-9pm

Classes will be held at:

Trinity Lutheran Church

2317 Buena Vista Ave.

Walnut Creek, CA 94597

Registration online is required. Do NOT show up without registering online as we will email study links & .PDF downloads with the class lessons to print and bring to class. Registration is $10 paid online.  We use the current ARRL Textbooks – Text book details are part of the registration process.  

Follow up training and License testing will also be available.

Complete class calendar and registration link: http://www.mdarc.org/activities/education/Classes

(If you are new to Ham Radio it is suggested you wait to buy your radio until after you take the TECH license class as some CHEAP radios advertised as Ham radios are out of compliance with FCC rules.)

The auto response at HamRadioClass@gmail.com will answer more class questions. Non License questions at info@mdarc.org
